issues.description: The mains cord and strain relief are listed, but their retention geometry and routing away from hot parts are unspecified.
issues.fix: Detail the cord anchor, bend protection, routing, and pull-test acceptance criteria in the assembly drawings.
issues.rule_citation: Provide and verify supply-cord anchorage and protection — IEC 60335-1; particular requirements for hair-care appliances — IEC 60335-2-23

issues.description: The heating assembly, cutouts, and plastic airflow components lack defined mounting locations and thermal-clearance requirements; overheating performance cannot be verified.
issues.fix: Define heat-resistant supports, cutout placement, and thermal-clearance limits; validate normal and abnormal-operation temperatures.
issues.rule_citation: Temperature-rise and abnormal-operation requirements — IEC 60335-1 and IEC 60335-2-23

issues.description: Shell mating-face and split-line requirements do not account for paint build-up or the combined variation of both shells.
issues.fix: Define masked mating surfaces or a controlled coating thickness, then tolerance the assembled split line after finishing.
issues.rule_citation: Account for coating thickness and tolerance stack-up at mating interfaces — ISO 2768-1 general tolerances; Protolabs injection molding design guide

issues.description: The specified boss pilot has no boss outside diameter, engagement depth, or edge-distance definition, so screw retention and cosmetic sink cannot be assessed.
issues.fix: Specify boss geometry and validate screw insertion torque, strip torque, and sink on molded samples.
issues.rule_citation: Keep boss walls near or below 60% of nominal wall to limit sink — Protolabs injection molding design guide

issues.description: Projected area along +Z: 9077 mm² (part silhouette, per cavity). Estimated clamp force ≈ 46.4 t (Estimate: area in² × 3.0 t/in² for PC/ABS × 1.1 safety) — per cavity; a family tool moulding both shells in one shot roughly doubles it.
issues.fix: Quote on a press ≥ 60 t; keep both shells in one family mould only if tonnage allows.
issues.rule_citation: Clamp force ≈ projected area × cavity-pressure factor (2-5 t/in²) — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines; silhouette raster from text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Silhouette along +Z, raster 0.375 mm — text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

issues.description: Measured wall 2.20-2.20 mm is within the PC/ABS 1.2-3.5 mm range; keep bosses/ribs ≤ 60% of nominal wall to avoid sink.
issues.fix: No change to nominal wall; core bosses and ribs to ≤ 60% of the wall.
issues.rule_citation: PC/ABS wall 1.2-3.5 mm, ribs/bosses ≤ 60% of wall — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines
